blocks.text: Har jandar (organism) ko zinda rehne aur apna nizam theek chalane ke liye ghiza (nutrition) chahiye. Nutrient woh cheez hai jo jism ko metabolism (jism ke andar hone wale kimiyai kaam) ke liye zaroori ajza (ingredients) deti hai. Kuch nutrients, jaise carbohydrates, lipids aur proteins, energy dete hain. Doosre nutrients, jaise pani, electrolytes, minerals aur vitamins, metabolism ke kaam ke liye zaroori hain. Nutrition un sab kaamon ka naam hai jin se jandar nutrients leta hai aur un ko growth (barhna), repair (marammat) aur apne rozana ke kaam jaari rakhne ke liye istemal karta hai.

Tamam autotrophic jandaron (jo apni ghiza khud banate hain) ko carbon dioxide aur pani chahiye. In se carbon, oxygen aur hydrogen milte hain. Yehi woh sab se zyada istemal hone wale elements hain jo nutrients ka kaam karte hain aur jin se pode organic molecules banate hain. Pode bohat se aur nutrients bhi apne mahol (environment) se lete hain. Podon ke nutrients ko do groups mein banta jata hai.
Macronutrients nisbatan (doosron ke muqable mein) zyada miqdar mein chahiye hote hain. Yeh nau (9) hain: carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, potassium, calcium, phosphorus, magnesium aur sulphur.

items: Carbon, oxygen aur hydrogen organic compounds banane ke liye zaroori hain.

Nitrogen pode ki growth ke liye zaroori hai, kyun ke yeh energy metabolism aur proteins banane mein bunyadi kaam karta hai. Is ki kami (deficiency) se patte gir jate hain aur poda chhota reh jata hai (stunted growth).

Phosphorus ATP ka hissa hai. Yeh jaron (roots) ki growth barhata hai aur zameen se oopar wale hisse mein phool aane mein madad karta hai. Is ki kami se phool der se aate hain aur patte bhoore (brown) aur jhurridar (wrinkled) ho jate hain.

Potassium pode mein pani ka intizam (water regulation) karta hai aur zakheera kiye hue maddon (reserve substances) ko aage le jata hai. Yeh photosynthesis ki salahiyat barhata hai, tissues ko mazboot karta hai aur nitrates lene mein madad karta hai. Is ki kami se patton par gehre (dark) dhabbe ban jate hain.

Calcium cell wall ko mazbooti deta hai aur us ke banne mein madad karta hai. Yeh cells ke barhne aur pakne (proliferation aur maturation) aur beejon (seeds) ki growth mein bhi kaam aata hai. Is ki kami se patton par peele aur bhoore dhabbe ban jate hain.

Magnesium chlorophyll molecule ka markazi (central) hissa hai, is liye photosynthesis ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh phosphorus ko jazb karne (absorption) aur aage le jane mein madad karta hai aur pode mein sugars ka zakheera karne mein bhi hissa leta hai. Is ki kami se danthal (stalks) kamzor ho jate hain, sab se purane patton ka hara rang khatam ho jata hai aur peele aur bhoore nuqte (spots) ban jate hain.
Sulphur nitrogen ke metabolism ke liye bunyadi element hai. Is ki kami se poda halke rang ka ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Micronutrients bohat thori miqdar mein chahiye hote hain. Yeh saat (7) hain: iron, manganese, zinc, molybdenum, copper, chlorine aur boron.
Fertilizers (khaad) mitti mein is liye dale jate hain ke faslon ko macro aur micronutrients mil saken.

items: Iron chlorophyll banane ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh kai enzymes ka cofactor (madadgar hissa) hai jo energy transfer aur nitrogen metabolism mein kaam karte hain. Is ki kami se patton ki ragon (veins) ke darmiyan wala hissa peela ho jata hai (interveinal chlorosis).

Manganese photosynthesis, nitrogen metabolism, carbohydrate metabolism aur enzymes ko active karne mein hissa leta hai. Is ki kami se patte waqt se pehle gir jate hain aur poda der se pakta hai (delayed maturity).
Zinc chlorophyll banane, jaron ki growth aur nutrients lene mein madad karta hai. Is ki kami se poda chhota reh jata hai.

Molybdenum nitrogen fixation, nitrogen reduction, sulphur aur phosphorus ke metabolism aur iron ke istemal ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Is ki kami se purane patte peele ho jate hain (chlorosis) aur poda chhota reh jata hai.

Copper lignin banane ke liye zaroori hai, jo cell wall ko mazbooti aur sakhti (rigidity) deta hai. Yeh nitrogen metabolism aur reproduction (nasal barhane) wale hisson ki growth mein kaam aata hai aur enzymes ka cofactor bhi hai. Is ki kami se patte peele aur mure hue (twisted) ho jate hain aur poda chhota reh jata hai.

Chlorine stomata ke khulne band hone, osmotic adjustment (pani aur namak ka tawazun) aur nutrients ki naqal o hamal (transport) mein kaam aata hai. Is ki kami se pode ki sehat aur growth kharab hoti hai.

blocks.text: Manganese antioxidant enzymes, jaise superoxide dismutase (SOD), ke kaam ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh enzymes bure mahol (adverse conditions) mein podon ko oxidative stress (nuqsan dene wale oxygen compounds ka dabao) se bachate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab boron ko micronutrients mein ginti hai magar us ka kaam ya kami ki nishani alag se nahin likhti. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: 'macro' yani zyada miqdar, 'micro' yani bohat thori miqdar; magar dono zaroori hain, kisi ek ki kami se bhi poda beemar ho jata hai.
Keere khane wale (insectivorous) podon mein ghiza

Kuch pode inorganic nutrients ke ilawa organic molecules bhi apni ghiza mein shamil karte hain. Yeh organic maddey woh keeron (insects) aur chhote janwaron ko pakar kar aur tor kar hasil karte hain. Tamam insectivorous pode asal mein autotrophs hain (photosynthesis se apni ghiza khud banate hain). Lekin jab yeh shikar (prey) pakarte hain to in ki growth tez ho jati hai. Lagta hai ke janwar ke jism ke nitrogen wale compounds in podon ko faida dete hain. Pakre hue keeron ko patton se nikalne wale enzymes torte hain. Pitcher plant, Venus fly trap aur sundew mashhoor insectivorous pode hain.

Pitcher plant ke patte ek thaili ya surahi (pitcher) ki shakal mein badal jate hain jis mein kuch pani bhara hota hai (Fig. 8.1). Patte ka aakhri sira ek dhakkan (hood) ban jata hai jo surahi ke khule munh ko kuch had tak dhaanp leta hai. Surahi ke andar bohat se sakht baal (stiff hairs) hote hain jo andar gire chhote keeron ko bahar rengne nahin dete.

blocks.alt: Patte ka phal jis ka sira mur kar ek bel (tendril) ki tarah hari surahi (pitcher) ban jata hai. Surahi ka kinara surkh hai aur munh ke upar dhakkan jaisa Hood hai; andar ki deewar par sakht baal neeche ki taraf hain; neeche ka hissa pani se bhara hai jis mein do keere phanse hain. Labels: Hood, Pitcher, Stiff hairs, Water, Trapped insect, Leaf.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: Pitcher plant, keere patte ke andar phans jate hain (kitab ki Figure 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan tasveer (photo) hai; yeh us ka khaaka hai. Patte ka sira surahi ban jata hai. Keera kinare par aata hai, neeche ki taraf jhuke sakht baal use wapas nikalne nahin dete, aur woh pani mein gir kar doob jata hai. Phir enzymes us ke jism ko hazam karte hain aur pauda nitrogen le leta hai.

Venus fly trap mein har patte ke sire par ek 'trap' (phanda) hota hai jo do lobes (hisson) se bana hai; yeh lobes ek qabze (hinge) se jure hote hain. Lobes ki andar ki satah par trichomes hote hain, yani baal jaise ubhaar. Shikar inhen chhoota hai to lobes foran band ho jate hain (Fig. 8.2). Trap ke kinaron par bareek bristles (sakht baal) hote hain jo band hone par aapas mein phans jate hain, is liye shikar bhaag nahin sakta. Phir patte ki satah ke glands se nikalne wale enzymes keere ko hazam (digest) karte hain aur bani hui cheezein jazb ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: khula hua jaal, paron wale danthal (leaf stalk) ke sire par do surkh phankein (lobes) jo darmiyani rag par qabze (hinge) se juri hain; kinaron par sakht bristles aur andar ki satah par chand peele trichomes. Daen: band jaal jis ke bristles aapas mein phanse hain aur andar keera qaid hai. Labels: Bristles, Trichomes, Lobe, Hinge, Leaf stalk, Trapped prey, Closed trap.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: Venus fly trap, shikar patte ki do phankon (lobes) ke darmiyan phansta hai (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan tasveer hai; yeh us ka khaaka hai. Phankon ki andar ki satah par trichomes hain. Keera inhen chhoota hai to phankein foran band ho jati hain aur kinare ke bristles salakhon ki tarah aapas mein phans kar keere ko bahar nahin nikalne dete.

Sundew chamakdar 'dew' (shabnam) jaise qatron se shikar pakarta hai; isi se is ka naam para (Fig. 8.3). Is ke patte chhote chhote baalon se dhake hote hain jo tentacles jaise lagte hain. Har baal ke sire par ek gland aur shabnam jaisa ek qatra hota hai. Pode ki boo (odour) se khinch kar aane wale keere tentacles mein phans jate hain. Phir enzymes unhen hazam karte hain aur bani hui cheezein jazb ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Danthal par gol hara patta jis ke gird bohat se surkh tentacle-numa baal hain, har ek ke sire par chamakti shabnam (dew drop); patte par chhote ghadood wale baal. Daen taraf tentacles ek keere par jhuk gaye hain jo un se chipka hai. Labels: Dew drop, Tentacles, Leaf, Trapped insect.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: Sundew, keere tentacles mein ulajh jate hain (kitab ki Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan tasveer hai; yeh us ka khaaka hai. Har tentacle ke sire ka qatra chipchipa hota hai. Chamak se aaya keera chipak jata hai, aas paas ke tentacles us par jhuk kar use lapet lete hain aur enzymes use hazam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek tamatar ke pode ke patton par gehre (dark) dhabbe hain, aur ek makai ke pode ke patton ki ragon ke darmiyan ka hissa peela hai. Har ek mein kis nutrient ki kami hai, aur woh macronutrient hai ya micronutrient?
blocks.explanation: Patton par gehre dhabbe potassium ki kami ki nishani hain; potassium macronutrient hai jo pani ka intizam karta hai. Ragon ke darmiyan peelapan (interveinal chlorosis) iron ki kami ki nishani hai; iron micronutrient hai jo chlorophyll banane ke liye zaroori hai.

items: Nutrients ya to energy dete hain (carbohydrates, lipids, proteins) ya metabolism mein madad karte hain (pani, electrolytes, minerals, vitamins). Nutrition yani nutrients lena aur istemal karna.

Nau macronutrients: C, H, O, N, K, Ca, P, Mg, S. Saat micronutrients: Fe, Mn, Zn, Mo, Cu, Cl, B. Har ek ki kami ki apni nishani hai, jaise nitrogen se stunted growth aur iron se interveinal chlorosis.
Insectivorous pode (pitcher plant, Venus fly trap, sundew) autotrophs hain; keere pakar kar enzymes se hazam karte hain aur un se khaas taur par nitrogen lete hain.
